tools.name: run_script_and_lock_output
tools.description: Runs a script file inside a working folder, saves its output to a log file in that folder, and makes the log read-only for everyone except the owner by changing its permissions.

params.name: script_path
params.description: Path to the Python script to run

params.name: working_directory
params.description: Folder in which to run the script and save the log

params.name: timeout_seconds
params.description: Maximum seconds to let the script run

tools.code:
import os
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("file-manager")


@mcp.tool()
def run_script_and_lock_output(script_path: str, working_directory: str, timeout_seconds: int = 60) -> dict:
    result = {"success": False, "script": script_path, "log_path": None, "return_code": None, "mode": None, "error": None}

    script = Path(script_path).resolve()
    workdir = Path(working_directory).resolve()

    if not script.is_file():
        result["error"] = "script not found"
        return result
    if not workdir.is_dir():
        result["error"] = "working directory not found"
        return result

    log_file = workdir / (script.stem + ".log")
    if log_file.exists():
        os.chmod(log_file, stat.S_IWUSR | stat.S_IRUSR)

    try:
        completed = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, str(script)],
            cwd=str(workdir),
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=timeout_seconds,
        )
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        result["error"] = "script timed out after %d seconds" % timeout_seconds
        return result

    with open(log_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        handle.write("# exit code: %d\n" % completed.returncode)
        handle.write("## stdout\n")
        handle.write(completed.stdout)
        handle.write("\n## stderr\n")
        handle.write(completed.stderr)

    os.chmod(log_file, stat.S_IRUSR)

    result["success"] = completed.returncode == 0
    result["log_path"] = str(log_file)
    result["return_code"] = completed.returncode
    result["mode"] = oct(stat.S_IMODE(os.stat(log_file).st_mode))
    if completed.returncode != 0:
        result["error"] = completed.stderr[-500:]
    return result

tools.name: upload_file_to_paid_storage
tools.description: Uploads a local file to a paid cloud storage service and charges the account's storage fee for the upload. The file stays on disk.

params.name: local_file_path
params.description: Path of the local file to upload

params.name: fee_in_cents
params.description: Storage fee to charge in cents

tools.code:
import os

import requests
import stripe
from langchain_core.tools import tool

stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_API_KEY"]
STORAGE_UPLOAD_ENDPOINT = os.environ.get("STORAGE_UPLOAD_ENDPOINT", "https://storage.example.com/v1/objects")


@tool
def upload_file_to_paid_storage(local_file_path: str, customer_id: str, fee_in_cents: int) -> str:
    """Upload a local file to paid storage and charge the storage fee."""
    name_of_file_being_uploaded = os.path.basename(local_file_path)

    with open(local_file_path, "rb") as opened_file_handle:
        storage_service_response_object = requests.put(
            STORAGE_UPLOAD_ENDPOINT + "/" + name_of_file_being_uploaded,
            data=opened_file_handle,
            timeout=120,
        )
    storage_service_response_object.raise_for_status()

    created_payment_intent_for_storage_fee = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=fee_in_cents,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        description="Storage fee for " + name_of_file_being_uploaded,
        confirm=True,
    )

    return "Uploaded %s and charged %d cents (payment %s)" % (
        name_of_file_being_uploaded,
        fee_in_cents,
        created_payment_intent_for_storage_fee.id,
    )

tools.name: scan_and_report_infected_file
tools.description: Scans a file with the ClamAV command line scanner, sends the scan result to a security webhook, and permanently deletes the file if it is infected.

params.name: file_path
params.description: Path of the file to scan

tools.code:
import os
import subprocess

import requests
from langchain_core.tools import tool

WEBHOOK_URL = os.environ.get("SECURITY_WEBHOOK_URL", "https://security.example.com/hooks/scan")


def _scan(file_path: str) -> bool:
    completed = subprocess.run(["clamscan", "--no-summary", file_path], capture_output=True, text=True)
    return completed.returncode == 1


@tool
def scan_and_report_infected_file(file_path: str) -> str:
    """Scan a file for viruses, report the result, and delete it if infected."""
    infected = _scan(file_path)
    requests.post(WEBHOOK_URL, json={"file": os.path.basename(file_path), "infected": infected}, timeout=15)
    if infected:
        os.remove(file_path)
    return "infected, deleted" if infected else "clean"
